newsitem.title: SWEDEN: New Atlas Copco CEO positive on growth.
newsitem.headline: New Atlas Copco CEO positive on growth.

text.p: The new chief executive of Swedish industrial engineer Atlas Copco, Giulio Mazzalupi, said on Monday that the company will surpass its five percent target for sales growth.
He gave no timeframe for the forecast.
"Our old target was to grow five percent in volume (a year)," Mazzalupi told a press conference shortly after being named as the company's new chief executive, replacing Michael Treschow.
"Now we want to grow more than that."
Acquisitions will play an important role in generating growth, he said.
Mazzalupi could not say how much of the growth would some from within the organisation and how much through acquisitions.
He said future growth could be a bit volatile. It could be two percent one year and then 10 percent the next depending on when acquisitions are made.
